files.auth.py: FastAPI security dependency: login, JWT generation, token verification, admin role check
files.fingerprint.py: Anonymous device fingerprinting (hash from user-agent + IP + timestamp), stored in IndexedDB for rate limiting
files.permissions.py: Role-based access control: inspector/coordinator/admin scopes per endpoint

services.geofencing.py: Geospatial logic: 30m duplicate prevention, 200m validation radius check using PostGIS ST_DistanceSphere, severity calculation by days open
services.incidents.py: Incident CRUD with geospatial validation, GeoJSON serialization, status transitions
services.validations.py: Validation logic: confirm/reject only within 200m radius, duplicate validator prevention
services.auth.py: Password hashing with bcrypt, token generation and verification using python-jose

schemas.incident.py: Pydantic models for incident creation/read/update with GeoJSON geometry export
schemas.auth.py: Token, login form, user out schemas
schemas.validation.py: Validation schema with location coords and confirmation flag

migrations.9f3a2c1_initial_schema.py: Alembic migration: creates users, incidents (with PostGIS POINT), validations, report_sequences tables with spatial indexes
